plugins.name: OMC QBS Relay
plugins.description: Multi-account Amazon Quick / QBS Relay provider for CLIProxyAPI and Oh-My-CPA. Adds one CPA auth per Quick session, registers sessions to qbs-upstream, and routes Anthropic / OpenAI requests through the upstream least-busy account pool.
plugins.author: Merrickk

zh-CN.description: 适用于 CLIProxyAPI / Oh-My-CPA 的多账号 Amazon Quick / QBS Relay 提供商插件。每个 Quick 会话生成一个独立 CPA 账号，自动注册到 qbs-upstream，并通过上游的 least-busy 账号池轮询处理 Anthropic / OpenAI 请求。
